exposure: participation in MamaCare group prenatal care
outcome: receipt of maternal human milk at discharge
cohort: 92 dyads where the mother participated in MamaCare group prenatal care for pregnancies complicated by prenatally diagnosed fetal anomalies.
finding: Of 85 surviving infants, 91.8% of mothers initiated lactation on delivery day or postpartum day 1, and 87.1% of infants were receiving maternal human milk at discharge from the initial intensive care unit stay.
followup_time: until discharge from the initial intensive care unit stay for infants
